title: Enhance AddItemSheet focus and last-used aisle defaults
description: Add auto-focus behavior to AddItemSheet and persist the last-picked aisle with SceneStorage so repeated item entry defaults to the prior aisle when it still exists in the current catalog.
acceptance_criteria: AddItemSheet uses FocusState so the item text field is focused when the sheet appears.
Opening AddItemSheet auto-summons keyboard focus reliably on supported sheet presentation paths.
AddItemSheet stores the last selected aisle name in SceneStorage when Add succeeds.
When a stored aisle still exists in catalog.aisles, the picker defaults to that aisle on open.
When there is no stored aisle or the stored aisle is absent from the current catalog, the sheet falls back to the existing default behavior without crashing.
The Other/default aisle path remains consistent when re-opening the sheet.

handoff_summary.completed: All six acceptance criteria satisfied: (1) @FocusState declared and bound to TextField; (2) .onAppear sets focus immediately; (3) lastUsedAisle SceneStorage written on successful Add; (4) applyLastUsedAisleDefault() pre-selects stored aisle when it exists in catalog.aisles; (5) missing/absent aisle falls back to nil (Other) without crashing; (6) Other/nil path unchanged when re-opening.
handoff_summary.risks: SceneStorage keyed on "addItemSheet.lastUsedAisle" is scene-scoped — multiple scenes sharing the same scene storage key will share the default, which is the intended behavior.
handoff_summary.next_action: Route to tester agent to verify focus behavior and SceneStorage persistence across sheet presentations.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — changes are self-contained to AddItemSheet.swift with no shared state beyond the SceneStorage key.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: SceneStorage stores "" (empty string) for the "Other"/nil aisle rather than an Optional, because SceneStorage does not support Optional<String>. applyLastUsedAisleDefault guards on non-empty before catalog lookup.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Tester should verify: (1) keyboard appears on sheet open, (2) aisle persists across sequential sheet presentations, (3) deleted aisle falls back to Other without crash, (4) first-launch (no stored value) behaves correctly.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: FocusState auto-focus may not fire if the sheet is presented inside a context that suppresses first-responder (e.g. some nested NavigationStack configurations on older iOS). Behavior on iOS 16 is untested since the project targets iOS 17+.

conflict_risks: None — changes are self-contained to AddItemSheet.swift with no shared state beyond the SceneStorage key.

execution_history.summary: Implemented FocusState auto-focus and SceneStorage last-used aisle persistence in AddItemSheet. Build verified clean.
